title: Graduation Requirements
text: Students must complete at least 135 credits with a minimum GPA of 2.0 to graduate.

title: Late Registration
text: Course registration after the official deadline incurs a late fee and requires Dean approval.

title: Exam Absence
text: Absence from final exams must be reported within 48 hours with medical or official evidence.

title: Internship Prerequisites
text: Students must have completed 90 credits before registering for the graduation internship.

title: Thesis Registration Credits
text: Thesis registration requires a minimum of 110 accumulated credits and thesis advisor approval.
